text: At its December 4, 2017 meeting, the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee considered a presentation from Barbara Shulman, Director, Strategic Recruitment, Compensation and Employment Services, Human Resources, on Employment Accessibility at the City of Toronto.

The Executive Committee: 1. Requested the City Manager to: a. develop targets and timelines for hiring under-represented groups within the Toronto Public Service and report to the Executive Committee by the end of the second quarter 2018; and b. consult with the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee prior to submitting any further reports to the Executive Committee related to hiring persons with disabilities.
